# web-storage

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./singularity build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Web-storage failure collector: drains the web-storage primitive's storageFailureReportSink into a deduped crash report (source client-storage, one row per owner and reason) for every write refused by an owner's cap or by the browser, and every stored entry that failed its owner's schema.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `WebStorageSlots.Root` → `StorageFailureCollector`
  - Uses:
    - `primitives/dom/web-storage.storageFailureReportSink`
    - `primitives/dom/web-storage.WebStorageSlots`
    - `reports.report`

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:END -->
